purpose: Determine whether the complete existing portfolio justifies continuation of the fixed universal coherence invariant candidate while preserving all negative constraints.

controlled_mechanism.rule: both controlled causal gauntlet and hidden-structure gauntlet must pass

cross_domain_measurement_signal.rule: at least two cross-sectional domains must support nonredundancy or hidden-collapse detection

external_system_transfer.rule: external-software route predictions >= 0.90 and matched-output route advantage over output-history >= 0.25

negative_constraint_integrity.rule: general observational superiority and multiplicative specificity must not be claimed if their frozen criteria fail
